text:
Anika Patel: ACME asked for a longer deprecation runway for pinned models. they want a "soft-retire" option + clear opt-back path. should we draft a playbook?
Liam Cho: are they hosted or dedicated?
Anika Patel: hosted. heavy usage, routes pinned to older quantized variants. migration caused perf regressions in their evals.
Maya Rivera: our default is 30d notice + 7d rollback. big ask. :thinking_face:
Carlos (CS): ACME asks for 90d + migration credits and canary lanes. must be able to opt back to old model if latency or quality drops.
Nora Eng: we can keep the old artifact and route by tag for a window, but infra + cost impact.
Anika Patel: draft proposal: announce 60d, soft-retire 60d (accept but rate-limit new sessions), 14d canary at 10% traffic with automated quality checks, keep old artifact + routing for 30d post-retire for emergency opt-back, offer migration credits + SRE support for first 14d.
Liam Cho: how do we define regression? eval delta or SLO impact?
Maya Rivera: hybrid: require both customer-eval pass >= baseline - 2% AND latency p95 <= 1.2x baseline.
Carlos (CS): customers will ask for SLAs during canary.
Nora Eng: possible if they pay for dedicated migration window; otherwise surface traces and rollback triggers only.
Anika Patel: sample rollout config for ops: {retire_notice_days:60, canary_days:14, canary_pct:10, quality_threshold_pct:-2, latency_p95_mult:1.2, rollback_days:30, migration_credit_usd:5000}
Liam Cho: make quality threshold configurable per-customer; some care more about embeddings.
Maya Rivera: require per-customer eval suite for exceptions; default to our benchmarks otherwise.
Carlos (CS): ACME wants a comms plan + in-console checklist and a customer-facing PDF.
Anika Patel: I'll draft comms + checklist. Nora, scope engineering for routing-by-tag + rate-limit mode?
Nora Eng: estimate ~3 engineer-weeks for maintenance routing + 2 weeks for admin UI and audit logs. add flag soft_retire=true and routing policy.
Liam Cho: add preflight in deploy pipeline to prevent accidental retire of pinned versions.
Maya Rivera: measure success: customer eval pass, <10% error-rate increase, <15% token-cost delta.
Anika Patel: canary_metrics = [eval_pass_rate, latency_p95, error_rate, token_cost_delta]; set alerts and auto-rollback triggers.
dev-bot: scheduled job model-retire-checker will post pins scheduled within 30d to #product. :robot_face:
Carlos (CS): loop in finance for migration credit accounting and legal for contract language. ACME wants to review draft.
Anika Patel: next steps: finalize playbook language + thresholds (this week), Nora to deliver scope & timeline (EOW), CS to prepare customer comm template (EOW).
Liam Cho: ping me when playbook ready, I'll add preflight checks.
Maya Rivera: I'll draft benchmark gating docs and sample eval command: python eval_runner.py --model candidate --suite acme_suite.json --baseline acme_baseline.json
Anika Patel: filing this as playbook draft. will post cleaned version and assign owners. :thumbsup:
Carlos (CS): thanks — I'll coordinate ACME review.
Nora Eng: noted. will link RFC once ready.
Anika Patel: end of thread.
